title: analysis.opportunity.v1
description: Transport-ready as of the Kafka transport task (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md; publisher: internal/transport/kafka/producer.go). Published by analysis-engine when a Strategy.Evaluate call produces a Candidate; consumed by algo-bot's target analysis_client package (docs/architecture/algo-bot.md, not built yet). Field shape mirrors analysis-engine/internal/opportunity.Candidate exactly (docs/architecture/analysis-engine.md) — this schema and that Go struct must be kept in sync by hand until a schema-to-struct generator exists (none does yet). Never contains a lot size, account balance, or risk multiplier — see docs/adr/002-analysis-vs-orchestration-boundary.md: an opportunity is a technical fact, not a trading decision. This is the PAYLOAD only — wrapped inside contracts/common/event-envelope-v1.schema.json's `payload` field; the envelope's own config_version/config_fingerprint carry "which configuration generated this," so algorithm_version below is scoped to the market-structure/liquidity algorithm identity specifically (source task §29's "algorithm version"), not configuration in general. No strategy is implemented yet (Analysis Engine V2 task) — this contract publishes no real events today; it exists ready for the first strategy task.

strategy.description: opportunity.StrategyID — an architectural slot name (e.g. "breakoutretest"), not yet a fixed enum since no strategy is implemented.

entry.description: opportunity.EntryZone — deliberately not internal/zone's richer Zone type; see docs/architecture/analysis-engine.md's naming note.

evidence.description: Machine-readable facts, per the source task's §25 — e.g. "major_structure_bearish", "m5_bos_down", "fvg_present". Never opaque free text.

quality.description: opportunity.StrategyQuality — strategy-specific components, per §26. Never a universal formula.

algorithm_version.description: Which versioned market-structure/liquidity algorithm produced the state this Candidate was derived from (engine.SnapshotVersion, source task §29's "algorithm version") — lets a replay/journal correlation ask "which exact algorithm generated this opportunity?" the same way config_version/config_fingerprint answer "which exact configuration."
